description: Get everything needed to decide on one evidence submission for one of your bounties, in one call: the listing (title, description, requirements, start instructions, and whether it was edited after the worker was accepted), the evidence types and completion questions agreed at acceptance, the submission's files typed photo/video/document, notes, links, completion answers, review cycle and advisory checks, earlier redo reasons, and the last messages of this worker's job chat labelled worker/owner/platform. Inspect every file before deciding with review_submission. Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty the submission belongs to

submissionId.description: The unique ID of the evidence submission to retrieve

name: get_submission_context
title: Get submission decision context
